EXPEDITION ROUTE

The Wayfarer Charter

PLAY YOUR WAY

Controls

Keyboard

Choose Change, then press one key. Escape cancels key capture; Tab returns to navigation. Each action needs a different key. Apply controls to keep your draft.

Mouse & touch

The battlefield and live controls work with either a mouse or a finger.

Aim & shoot
Pull-back from hero: press the glowing ring, draw back, then release. Pull-back anywhere starts wherever you press. Point and Auto aim fire toward the point you press; lead moving enemies. Change your aim style in Settings.
Choose an ability
Click or tap its card on the live action bar. Keyboard slots stay 1–9, then 0. Basic Arrow begins on 1; arrange your cards in Loadout.
Change bars
Scroll the mouse wheel over the battlefield, or tap the bar-cycle control. Only equipped bars appear.
Airborne activation
The Burst / Storm control appears when the current airborne ability can activate. Its keyboard shortcut is separate from aiming and shooting.
Look around on a phone
In portrait, drag the small map to pan. Hero returns to your bow; Whole field shows the battlefield.
Menu navigation
Escape stays Back / Pause. Tab moves focus; Enter and Space activate buttons. Browser shortcuts and keys 1–9 / 0 are reserved.
Precise shot
An optional control fires your saved angle and power. Enable it in Settings → Precision if you want it.

Keyboard preferences are stored only in this browser. They apply across your sessions here and are separate from campaign progress and exported files.

Back, Cancel, or Escape discards unapplied key changes.

MUSTER & ORDERS

More
Field rules

Field slots include regular troops in the field, arriving at the edge, garrisoned, and fallen bodies until they clear.

Reserve is supplied again for each new battle or retry, according to its campaign or practice kit. It pays for squads in that battle; field slots are a separate limit.

Owned troop contracts and their ranks survive casualties and defeat. Gold spent on squads is not returned.

Companions use their own slot and controls in Loadout.

Contracts & ranks survive defeat

Temporary levies

Four finite waves: 3 foot soldiers, 1 archer and 1 healer each, all rank 2. No gold or reserve cost; no contracts or skill XP. Frontline / Support orders apply. Bodies retain their levy slots until cleared. The L pennant marks temporary troops.

Holding the line

Field slots include keep guards. Hero and companion are separate.

Waiting to enter

FIRST IN · FIRST OUT

Time is stopped in the command tent.

Squads spend gold and reserve now, then enter after Resume. Owned contracts and ranks survive defeat. Reserve refills for each new battle or retry; spent gold is not returned.

Placement & controls

Any ability fits any of the 30 action-bar keys. Tap a card, then a destination key to place it. Filled keys swap. Placing a reserve card on a filled key returns that card to reserve; you keep both.

Drag from a card’s dotted handle or a filled key. Hover over a bar tab to switch bars. Release outside a key or press Escape to cancel a drag.

Keyboard: Tab and Enter select cards and keys. Inspect opens details without changing your placement selection. During battle, keys 1–9 and 0 activate the current bar; G controls your separate companion. Reserve abilities stay owned but do not cool down.
